g.text: E-stop 1: button released (contact closed) -> D2 LOW, LED lit

g.desc: E-stop 1: button released (contact closed) -> D2 LOW, LED lit

g.text: Safety inputs: 2 e-stops + 2 lidars, 24 V through PC817 - shield for Arduino UNO R4 WiFi / UNO Q

g.desc: Safety inputs: 2 e-stops + 2 lidars, 24 V through PC817 - shield for Arduino UNO R4 WiFi / UNO Q

g.text: Lidar 2: output at 24 V (zone clear) -> D5 LOW, LED lit

g.desc: Lidar 2: output at 24 V (zone clear) -> D5 LOW, LED lit

g.text: Lidar 1: output at 24 V (zone clear) -> D4 LOW, LED lit

g.desc: Lidar 1: output at 24 V (zone clear) -> D4 LOW, LED lit

g.text: E-stop 2: button released (contact closed) -> D3 LOW, LED lit

g.desc: E-stop 2: button released (contact closed) -> D3 LOW, LED lit

g.text: E-stop loops: 3.3 k -> 6.3 mA (0.20 W at 28.8 V). Lidar inputs: 4.7 k -> 4.4 mA (0.14 W). R1-R4 are 1/2 W (body 9 x 3.2 mm); pull-ups 1/4 W.

g.desc: E-stop loops: 3.3 k -> 6.3 mA (0.20 W at 28.8 V). Lidar inputs: 4.7 k -> 4.4 mA (0.14 W). R1-R4 are 1/2 W (body 9 x 3.2 mm); pull-ups 1/4 W.

g.text: C1-C4 are OPTIONAL: fitted, an opening shorter than about 1.5 ms is not seen by the Arduino, and every stop is seen about 1.6 ms later.

g.desc: C1-C4 are OPTIONAL: fitted, an opening shorter than about 1.5 ms is not seen by the Arduino, and every stop is seen about 1.6 ms later.

g.text: No current (button pressed, zone occupied, wire cut, 24 V lost) -> pin HIGH = STOP. F1 protects the 24 V wires going out to the buttons.

g.desc: No current (button pressed, zone occupied, wire cut, 24 V lost) -> pin HIGH = STOP. F1 protects the 24 V wires going out to the buttons.

g.text: GND_24V and GND are NOT connected: this is the isolation barrier. Pull-ups go to IOREF (5 V on UNO R4 WiFi, 3.3 V on UNO Q), never to 5V.

g.desc: GND_24V and GND are NOT connected: this is the isolation barrier. Pull-ups go to IOREF (5 V on UNO R4 WiFi, 3.3 V on UNO Q), never to 5V.
